stories.title: Shot of the Day
stories.detail: Eagle on the 16th - the pick of the day

stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: 38 pts for Glen White, top of the table and the sausage sizzle already fired up for the presentation.

stories.title: Absolute Menace
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 5 & 18 - the rest of us should consider going home

stories.title: Nailbiter
stories.detail: one point splits the top two - down to the wire

stories.title: The Charge
stories.detail: 20 on the back nine after 14 on the front - flying home

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 105 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: The Bolter
stories.detail: Gregory Knight surged 9 spots, the sort of charge that has the coaching staff grinning.

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: A warm country welcome to Taylor Bentley, visiting us today from Bankstown GC.

stories.title: Away-Day Raid
stories.detail: Visitor from Gold Creek CC sitting 5th - raiding the local silverware

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 3 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 6 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 4 wipes in 18 holes - technically a very consistent performance

stories.title: Rough Patch
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 17 & 18 - club still in the bag

stories.title: The Bounce Back
stories.detail: Wipe then a 3-pointer on holes 14 & 15

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Clean but Not Pretty
stories.detail: 7 1-pointers and not a single wipe - disciplined mediocrity

stories.title: Speed Bump
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 14, wipe on hole 15 - the course corrects

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: Rock Solid
stories.detail: Zero wipes and 8 two-pointers - boring in the best way

stories.title: Under the Radar
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ through the round - not flashy, just effective

stories.title: The Phoenix
stories.detail: Wipe then 3-pointer on holes 12 & 13 - drama then redemption

stories.title: Brilliant and Then Not
stories.detail: 4-pointer on hole 14, wipe on hole 15 - the heart rate approves

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 6, 7 & 8

stories.title: Slow Starter
stories.detail: Nil from the first 4 on holes 1-4

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Colin Rava led at three-quarter time, and 5th to 14th says the closing stanza got away.

comingLast.roast: off 8 and famous for the wrong reasons - 24 does that
one decent hole (8 points) and he slips the blue ball noose onto Webster
on 18 - the escape committee (his foursome) has convened
7 points buys freedom - Webster is pricing it higher by the minute
3 holes of runway left - 3 points clears the fence
1 point clear from the bar - watching Webster like a hawk with a beer
2 above Webster and in - now it is all spectator sport with stakes
